name: Herennius Etruscus
contribution: Briefly Roman emperor in 251, ruling jointly under his father Decius.

checks.lead: Herennius Etruscus (Latin: Quintus Herennius Etruscus Messius Decius; died c. June 251) was briefly Roman emperor in 251, ruling jointly under his father Decius. His father was proclaimed emperor by his troops in September 249 while in Pannonia and Moesia, in opposition to Philip. Decius defeated Philip in battle, and was then proclaimed emperor by the Senate. Etruscus, still a child, was elevated to Caesar (heir) in 250, then further raised to Augustus (emperor) in May 251.
